title: Xdrip + Libre3
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3536
Originally posted by **Kustomwireless** June 14, 2024 Can someone explain why Xdrip + is not able to work direct with Libre 3 as some of the other Apps do such as Juggluco?? Some back round We have been using Xdrip + for about 8 years with US Libre and Blucon also bubble. For Now We are using Juggluco to send data to Xdrip + and it seems to be working pretty well. With one exception and that is the sensors seem to stop working 2 to 3 days early consistently don't know if there is a connection or not! Just looking to simplify things for my wife. Is there any other way accomplish what we are doing?? I also follow her with Xdrip.
